query: What is the listing policy for DHA properties in 2026?
responseAnswer:
The listing policy for DHA properties in 2026 requires a signed form A from the landlord before advertising, which forms the baseline of listing compliance. [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781232148245.txt", Page 1, Para 1]

Additionally, commission rates for sales agents in 2026 are capped at 2.5% maximum of the deal size, unless approved by the Super Admin in writing. [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781232148245.txt", Page 1, Para 1] and [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781233474811.txt", Page 1, Para 1]

Subletting apartments without tenant registration with the organization portal is strictly prohibited and results in a fine of 5000 AED. [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781232148245.txt", Page 1, Para 1] and [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781233474811.txt", Page 1, Para 1]
